slices.focus: Ayaka gets formal approval for a winter resilience test with posted notice targets, emergency cargo tags, and a shared recovery checklist for same-day weather changes.
slices.summary: Management approves a winter resilience test with a posted 15-minute notice-update target, designated emergency cargo tags, and a shared recovery checklist for same-day weather service changes. The checklist uses both whiteboard and spreadsheet so one side can fail without losing the system. Supervisors agree to use it whenever service conditions shift within the same day — the gap that previously caused the most confusion. Ayaka defines three measurable success criteria.
open_loops: First rough day could still collapse the test
Staff may quietly revert to old habits even with posted standards
Three success criteria may not capture full operational picture
